title: Azusawa Kohane — I'll Protect You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone from the promo and maze teams, thank you for your patience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The costume team will now be doing a little fashion show and photo shoot to take promotional pics for our haunted house!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Classmates
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get why everyone's excited, but the promo team can't seem to contain themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We heard that the costumes turned out really amazing, so we can't wait to see them!

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member A
rows.Line: Also, getting to take pictures of them means our work's just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, so...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we only have the costume for one wolf and Little Red Riding Hood's hood ready...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Are these really gonna be enough?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup! We have the trees Shiho and her team made, so these should be more than enough!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, Shiho, can we borrow some of your trees?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course. We had a feeling that you guys would need them, so we made sure to get them done the day before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much! That helps a lot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ahem. Now then!
We'll start with the costume for Wolf #1!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa! It looks so real!

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member B
rows.Line: Yeah. I was kinda wondering how it'd turn out at first after I heard that they were making it out of cardboard and a helmet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same. I can't believe how realistic it is.

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student A
rows.Line:
This is awesome, costume team!
How did you guys make this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we used a helmet and some cardboard to put the face together. Once that was done, we draped some cloth over it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we gave it some eyes, ears and fangs! And voila, it was done!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, this wolf is meant to be not so scary for those who aren't exactly thrill seekers. As such, the eyes are meant to look kinda cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, the way they're drooping a little's kind of cute!

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student B
rows.Line: I agree. Even if you ran into it, you could probably just say hi to it and walk away.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. An should be able to enjoy this sort of haunted house.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll start taking some photos now!
Also, if you don't mind, could you put it on and pose like you're trying to scare someone?

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student A
rows.Line: Okay! Lemme try putting it on!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: We'll help! First, you need to look for the zipper on the back... Here, it's this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You tried to make the cloth look like a wolf's fur, right? Are you sure about using just gray for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I see what she means... I think wolves have white fur around their mouths. A lot of dogs too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you need fabric paint, you can borrow some from the maze team.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho!
I probably didn't realize sooner because Samo's all white!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks, Hinomori! We should be able to get it to look even more wolflike now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank me.
It was just something I happened to notice.

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line:
Still, good eye.
Wait, Hinomori, do you like animals...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? It's not like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Shiho really loves adorably fluffy, little bunny rabbits that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A-Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you giggling, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just... You're so cute, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? You sound like my sister...

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member A
rows.Line:
Kohane! Everyone!
She's done putting on the wolf costume! Let's start taking some pictures!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please make a really, really amazing flyer for us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You all worked really hard on making these, so I promise to make something really good with the promo team!
